scope: Exact finite arithmetic-sum counterexamples, staircase algebra checks, and selected complete-source point enclosures. No height-cover or all-height assertion.
theta_convention: theta=t*log(x), as in Note16; convert explicitly when comparing a theorem using t*log(x/(4pi))
common_sum_definition: D_j=sum_(n<=exp(2b)) n^(-1/2) exp(t*d_n²-2t*d_n*(b+ia)-i*x*d_n) (-a+i*(b-d_n))^j; a=pi/16, b=log((x+2ta)/(4pi sin4a))/4

staircase_transitions.jump_identity: carrier(d_n) A_n(d_n) (-a)^j = exp(-t*a²) phi_n(i*a) (-a)^j; external exp(-a*x) omitted on both sides

four_jet_perturbation_bounds.argument: Each linear error has absolute bound <=4delta because |c|,|s|<=1; keep the positive error square and pay the single negative error product by delta². The norm has positive error squares and linear loss <=4delta.

endpoint_cancellation_observation: The full carrier cancels every exp(-i*x*d_n) staircase jump phase. After summing every index, g_j(z)=(iz)^j exp(tz²)Phi(z) satisfies conjugate(g_j^(r)(ia))=(-1)^r g_j^(r)(ia), so every inverse-x boundary coefficient i^(-r-1)g_j^(r)(ia) has zero real part. This is an analytic consequence of complete-source evenness, not a numerical proof of an all-height sign.
limitations: The shared arithmetic sum is an exact integrand object; its forms are not the complete integrated theta Laguerre forms.
Failure of the all-phase integrand cone does not contradict positivity using the actual carrier and integration.
All counterexamples use theta=1 or2 and do not contradict an outer-region theorem with theta>=4+epsilon.
Paid complete-source points do not establish stationarity, rectangle coverage, or uniform relative errors.
